name: Create factory branches without tracking origin/main
description:
Factory review recommendation 6 of 20.

## Context

A reviewed task branch tracked origin/main, creating a risk that an upstream-style push targets main.

## Acceptance criteria

- Create task branches from the intended base with tracking disabled.
- Require the first push to set the upstream to the task branch.
- Update worktree guidance and verify branch/upstream configuration on a representative worktree.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.
